title: Nvidia is pouring $1 billion into South Korea’s AI infrastructure through Naver and SK Group
excerpt: Nvidia will invest $1 billion in South Korean internet company Naver to help finance an AI data center under construction in South Korea, the chipmaker announced late Friday. content_html:
TL;DR

Nvidia is investing $1 billion in Naver and building a $500 billion commercial partnership with SK Group spanning data centers and memory chips

Nvidia will invest $1 billion in South Korean internet company Naver to help finance an AI data center under construction in South Korea, the chipmaker announced late Friday. The funding will allow Naver to more than triple the size of the facility from 55 megawatts to 200 megawatts, with US private equity firm Brookfield agreeing to a nonbinding term sheet to fund up to $9 billion for the project. The site will run on Nvidia’s AI computing hardware.

Separately, Nvidia announced a long-term commercial partnership with SK Group that it described as worth more than $500 billion. The figure includes money Nvidia will spend buying memory chips from SK Hynix, the world’s largest supplier of high-bandwidth memory, as well as purchases by SK Group of Nvidia’s supercomputers. SK Telecom will build more than 2 gigawatts of AI data centers on the Korean Peninsula, with the first facility due to open next year.

The announcements coincide with a visit to Silicon Valley by South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, and additional tech deals between Korean and American companies are reportedly in the works. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told Bloomberg Television that South Korea is in a “golden age,” pointing to the country’s booming semiconductor and industrial businesses as reasons to invest. Nvidia will also help SK Hynix design future high-bandwidth memory chips, an effort to guarantee access to the component that remains in short supply because of the global buildout of AI data centers.

The Korea deals are the latest in a year-long investment spree in which Nvidia has committed more than $40 billion to AI equity positions, including $30 billion in OpenAI. Earlier this week the chipmaker signed a separate agreement with Amkor Technology to bolster chip packaging, and it recently completed a trip to Japan that included deals with Toyota and Japanese robotics firms. Critics have described the pattern as circular financing, in which Nvidia invests in companies that then buy its hardware, a structure the chipmaker has replicated with data center operators, neoclouds, and now sovereign AI partners.

For South Korea, the deals represent a bet that its semiconductor industry can remain central to the AI buildout even as geopolitical tensions reshape chip supply chains. Samsung and SK Hynix are the only two companies in the world capable of producing the advanced memory chips that Nvidia’s processors require, and locking in a design partnership with Nvidia gives SK Hynix a structural advantage over its rival. Huang has argued that every country should create its own sovereign AI capability, and South Korea, with its chipmaking expertise and abundant engineering talent, is among the best positioned to do so.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

Nvidia 将向 Naver 投资 10 亿美元，并与 SK 集团建立价值 5000 亿美元的商业合作伙伴关系，涵盖数据中心和存储芯片

芯片制造商英伟达 (Nvidia) 周五晚间宣布，将向韩国互联网公司 Naver 投资 10 亿美元，为韩国正在建设的人工智能数据中心提供资金。 这笔资金将使 Naver 将该设施的规模扩大两倍以上，从 55 兆瓦增至 200 兆瓦，美国私募股权公司 Brookfield 同意一份不具约束力的条款清单，为该项目提供高达 90 亿美元的资金。 该网站将在英伟达的人工智能计算硬件上运行。

另外，Nvidia 宣布与 SK 集团建立长期商业合作伙伴关系，据称价值超过 5000 亿美元。 该数字包括英伟达将从全球最大的高带宽内存供应商SK海力士购买内存芯片的资金，以及SK集团购买英伟达超级计算机的资金。 SK Telecom 将在朝鲜半岛建设超过 2 吉瓦的人工智能数据中心，第一个设施将于明年开业。

这些公告恰逢韩国总统李在明访问硅谷之际，据报道，韩国和美国公司之间的其他技术交易正在进行中。 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋告诉彭博电视台，韩国正处于“黄金时代”，并指出该国蓬勃发展的半导体和工业业务是投资的理由。 英伟达还将帮助 SK 海力士设计未来的高带宽存储芯片，以确保能够使用因全球人工智能数据中心建设而供应短缺的组件。

韩国交易是英伟达长达一年的投资热潮中的最新一起，英伟达已承诺向 AI 股权投资超过 400 亿美元，其中包括 300 亿美元的 OpenAI。 本周早些时候，这家芯片制造商与 Amkor Technology 签署了一项单独协议，以加强芯片封装，最近还完成了一次日本之行，其中包括与丰田和日本机器人公司的交易。 批评者将这种模式描述为循环融资，即英伟达投资于公司，然后购买其硬件，该芯片制造商已与数据中心运营商、neoclouds 以及现在的主权人工智能合作伙伴复制了这种结构。

对于韩国来说，这些交易代表着一种赌注，即即使地缘政治紧张局势重塑芯片供应链，韩国的半导体行业仍然可以成为人工智能建设的核心。 三星和 SK 海力士是世界上仅有的两家能够生产 Nvidia 处理器所需的先进存储芯片的公司，与 Nvidia 锁定设计合作伙伴关系使 SK Hynix 相对于竞争对手具有结构性优势。 黄仁勋认为，每个国家都应该建立自己的主权人工智能能力，而韩国凭借其芯片制造专业知识和丰富的工程人才，是最有能力做到这一点的国家之一。
